definitions.gloss: completion; finish; result (of work or a game)
stepping up into a house; entryway; green tea (at a sushi restaurant)

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧. Has a wide range of meanings depending on context, from financial gains to the quality of a finished product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{売|う}り→売る：00906_uru⟧{上|あ}がり: sales, revenue
- {出来|でき}{上|あ}がり: completion, finished product
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧: finishing, final result
- ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|あ}がり: rise in prices
- {上|あ}がり{框|がまち}: entryway step (in a Japanese house)

SUSHI RESTAURANT USAGE:
At sushi restaurants, {上|あ}がり is the traditional term for green tea. This is part of the specialized vocabulary (sushi terminology) used at the counter. Customers may use this word to request tea at the end of their meal.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧: rise, ascent — more formal and used for measurable increases
- ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: income — specifically refers to money earned
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧: completion — emphasizes the finished state of a project or work
